Daily Devotional

August 24

11 But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of God, it is evident: for, The just shall live by faith. 12 And the law is not of faith: but, The man that doeth them shall live in them. 13 Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree: (Galatians 3:11-13 KJV)

“The just shall live by faith” is a quotation from Habakkuk 2:4 and is also quoted in Romans 1:17 and Hebrews 10:38. No man can be justified in the sight of God by keeping the law, as only one man ever was able to keep the whole law, the man Jesus Christ (Matthew 5:17). If any try to live by the law, like so many churches teach, then you can be sure that you will fail, and if you fail in any one point, the Bible says you are guilty of it all (James 2:10). Jesus brought us a new covenant, and we now only have to love to fulfill the whole law (Matthew 12:30-31) – Praise God!

The fact that Jesus kept the law, and redeemed us from it by nailing it to the cross with Him (Colossians 2:14), means that we now are not under the law and Old Testament commandments – Thank you Jesus! I have a very hard time understanding why the religious people still try to put Christians under the law of having to do everything and live holy to be right with God, as that is not what the Bible is teaching, and is not the “Good News” of the Gospel. I suppose that the devil has put forth that doctrine and the churches have bought into it. Shame on them for their lack of understanding the Word of God.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
